opening: I've been keeping to myself. I've stopped contacting my family and friends.
It's been happening over the past several months. Before that I was socially active.
My mother brought me in because she says my personality has changed a lot.
I'm worried that aliens are watching me.
I'm worried that aliens are stealing my thoughts.
I used to smoke marijuana occasionally, but I quit a year ago.
